text:
marta-docs: opened a tiny PR to clarify TTL wording on the audit-log page and add a curl + CLI migration snippet: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/900

chris-legal: quick legal flag: avoid absolutes like 'indefinite', 'permanent', or 'forever' in public docs. SOC2 reviewers want explicit scope + legal-hold exception.

ryan-eng: thanks. also caught a mismatch in the curl example 6 the JSON shape our API now expects. examples currently post `ttl` at top-level; server expects a `retention_policy` object. small diff below:
```diff
- curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit -d '{"tenant":"org_1","ttl":3600}'
+ curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"tenant":"org_1","retention_policy":{"mode":"ttl","seconds":3600}}'
```

emily-privacy: suggested concise public line: "Audit logs are retained according to customer-configured retention policies; Redwood does not retain logs beyond those settings except to comply with legal obligations (e.g., legal holds)."

chris-legal: that reads well. prefer 'does not retain' (stronger). Also: remove direct links to internal legal playbooks and replace with '(contact support)' if needed.

ryan-eng: adding a short CLI read example for migration docs customers asked for:
```
# show retention policy
rctl audit get --tenant org_1 --output json
# sample output
{
  "tenant": "org_1",
  "retention_policy": {"mode": "ttl", "seconds": 3600},
  "pseudonymize": false
}
```

marta-docs: thanks all. I'll update the curl/py/js snippets to use `retention_policy` and add the CLI sample. Also removing internal playbook link and swapping to contact support per legal.

docs-ci: PR #900 checks 3 unit-tests: passed, link-checker: warning (1 internal link), lint: passed

marta-docs: noted CI warning 6 removed the internal link. Pushing small commit now, will request a quick legal + privacy pass. :+1:

chris-legal: I'll do a quick re-read after the commit. thx!

emily-privacy: LGTM once pseudonymization examples are present in the snippets (customers ask about PII handling).

marta-docs: adding pseudonymize flag to the examples and pushing. planning to merge once CI is green and legal approves. thanks everyone! :tada:
